Release History

v1.1.9

What's new and improved:

  • Export portable, encrypted backups and preview them before restoring on another device.
  • Load older messages in your conversations; message notifications and deep links are now more reliable.
  • Improved data integrity across pair, incubation, egg, and chick records, plus a smoother, more responsive calendar.
  • Stabilized Premium plans, purchases, restores, and subscription activation.
  • Improved accessibility, performance, and overall app stability.

Thanks for your feedback!

v1.0.3

What's new and improved:

  • Community and AI features are now marked "Coming Soon" — they'll roll out to everyone once development is complete.
  • Performance improvements: faster database sync and list rendering.
  • Genetics calculator updated: more accurate results for dominant mutation series and a refreshed probability table.
  • Fixed a duplicate-record issue in background sync.
  • Various bug fixes and UI polish.

Thanks for your feedback!
